summary: Licensed FAA Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) aviation mechanic with roughly five years of hands-on experience maintaining aircraft across airframe, powerplant, electrical, hydraulic, and flight control systems. Performs scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, troubleshooting, major and minor repairs, post-flight inspections, and FAA-compliant maintenance recordkeeping, including heavy maintenance such as annual inspections and engine, gearbox, and propeller changes. Brings military aviation technical training and leadership experience, supervision of large maintenance crews (logged over 1,800 supervisory hours), and supply chain management. Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt certified with a focus on quality assurance and process improvement.
